clubs.name: Gilbert – Heritage
clubs.personality: Lifting platforms and a rooftop at golden hour.
clubs.photo: Heritage, rooftop mobility deck at golden hour, palo verde in the corner
clubs.parking: Street parking and a rear lot.

coaches.name: Sam Okafor
coaches.about: I help people come back after surgery or a long break. We start with what your body can do today. No lectures.

coaches.name: Elena Duarte
coaches.about: Snatch, clean and jerk, taught in small pieces. Bring your current lifts. We build from there.

coaches.name: Marcus Hale
coaches.about: Most swimmers are one fix away from a faster, easier lap. We film your stroke and fix the biggest thing first.

coaches.name: Rosa Lindgren
coaches.about: Pickleball is a lot of lunging. I build the hips, ankles and shoulders that let you play four mornings a week.

coaches.name: Jake Whitcomb
coaches.about: Teens get stronger by learning to move well first. Parents are welcome to watch the first session.
goodFor: First time in a weight room

rrs.name: Rib Rack Strength
rrs.about: Squat, press, pull. Five lifts built on one rack, coached in small groups. Pick your own weight; the coach sets the tempo.

bb.name: Barbell Basics
bb.about: Learn the bar. Hips, hinge, press and row with a light barbell and plenty of cues. A good first strength class.

kf.name: Kettlebell Flow
kf.about: Swings, carries and getups linked into one flowing circuit. Light bells are fine.

ofl.name: Olympic Lifting Club
ofl.about: Open coaching on the platforms. Bring a plan or ask for one. Heritage only.

cc.name: Climb Cycle
cc.about: Hills, not hype. Climb Cycle follows a mountain profile: warm-up, three climbs, a long descent. Set your own resistance. Nobody checks.

ride.name: Rhythm Ride
ride.about: Ride to the beat. Steady cadence, lots of seated work, and a playlist you can feel in your legs.

e60.name: Endurance 60
e60.about: One hour of aerobic work at a pace you can hold. Good Saturday legs.

sbh.name: Switchback HIIT
sbh.about: Thirty minutes of work and rest, in switchbacks. Intervals scale to you. All-out means your all-out.

crc.name: Canal Run Club
crc.about: Out and back on the canal path. Three paces, one meeting point, nobody left behind.

bc.name: Bootcamp
bc.about: Stations, sleds and a friendly drill sergeant who also says please.

bring: Mat if you prefer your own
dfy.name: Desert Flow Yoga
dfy.about: A slow vinyasa with long holds. Mats and blocks are provided. Finish with five quiet minutes.

mp.name: Mat Pilates
mp.about: Core, hips and posture on the mat. Small movements, done well.

bw.name: Breathwork
bw.about: Thirty minutes lying down, breathing on purpose. Quiet room, no pretzels.

af.name: Aqua Fit
af.about: Low-impact cardio in the pool. Easy on knees and hips, harder than it looks.

ms.name: Masters Swim
ms.about: Coached lap sets for adult swimmers. Three lanes by pace. Bring a pull buoy.

ss.name: Swim School
ss.about: Small-group lessons for children 4 to 12, grouped by level. A parent stays on the deck.

pcl.name: Pickleball Clinic
pcl.about: Drills for the dink, the third shot and where to stand. Paddles are provided.

pop.name: Pickleball Open Play
pop.about: Drop in and rotate. Courts are sorted by level. Paddle rack by the door.

td.name: Tennis Drills
td.about: Forehands, backhands and footwork with a coach and a hopper of balls.

hr.name: Hoops Run
hr.about: Full-court pickup, refereed lightly. Winners stay on.

m30.name: Mobility 30
m30.about: Thirty minutes of hips, shoulders and spine. The class you take after the class you took.

sr.name: Stretch & Release
sr.about: Long stretches with foam rollers and bands. Recovery for the legs you used yesterday.

ts.name: Teen Strength
ts.about: Strength basics for ages 13 to 17. Movement first, weight second. Coached by Hannah Cole.

jp.name: Junior Pickleball
jp.about: Ages 8 to 14. Small courts, soft balls, loud cheering.

items.q: How far ahead can I book?
items.a: Classes open 7 days ahead (Summit: 9 days) at 6:00 a.m. Arizona time on the opening day. Courts open 3 days ahead.

Cancel free up to 2 hours before start. Later counts as a late cancel. Three late cancels in 30 days pause new class, court and lane booking for 3 days. A no-show counts as a late cancel. Kids club has no strikes.

items.q: What happens when a class is full?
items.a: Join the waitlist (up to 5 at once). When a spot opens you get a push and 30 minutes to tap Confirm spot. We stop moving people up 1 hour before class; after that, open spots show as drop-in spots.
Courts come with Ridge and Summit. Reserve 60 or 90 minutes, up to 3 days ahead. One court per day and two active at a time. Cancel free until 2 hours before.
Yes. Up to 2 swimmers share a lane, in circle swim. Lane slots are 45 minutes. Lap lanes have no waitlist.

items.q: Who can go to kids club?
items.a: Children from 6 months to 12 years. Blocks are 2 hours, Monday to Saturday. A parent checks in at the same club and stays in the club. An unclaimed block is released 15 minutes after it starts.
On your billing day each month. The $49 annual facility fee is charged in March. If a payment fails we retry on day 3 and day 6, and you keep full access through day 7.
Freeze for 1, 2 or 3 months at $10 per month. A freeze starts on the first billing date at least 30 days after you ask.
Cancel from Membership with 30 days' notice. You keep full access until the end date and can keep your membership with one click until then.
Guests are 18 or older, or 16 and 17 with a parent or guardian waiver. A pass is good for one visit at one club and lasts 14 days. Ridge includes 1 per month, Summit 4.
